endpoints.summary: Get the list of configured data sources
endpoints.description: Provides the implementation of GET /data-sources. Returns an SzDataSourcesResponse describing the configured data sources, optionally including the raw native Senzing JSON.

endpoints.summary: Get a single configured data source
endpoints.description: Provides the implementation of GET /data-sources/{dataSourceCode}. Returns an SzDataSourceResponse for the specified data source code, optionally including the raw native Senzing JSON.

endpoints.summary: Add one or more data sources
endpoints.description: Provides the implementation of POST /data-sources. Adds data sources specified via query parameters and/or request body and returns an SzDataSourcesResponse with all configured data sources.

endpoints.summary: Get the list of attribute types
endpoints.description: Provides the implementation of GET /attribute-types. Returns an SzAttributeTypesResponse describing attribute types, optionally filtered by attribute class and feature type and optionally including internal attribute types and raw native Senzing JSON.
Provides the implementation of GET /attribute-types/{attributeTypeCode}. Returns an SzAttributeTypeResponse for the specified attribute code, optionally including the raw native Senzing JSON.
Provides the implementation of GET /configs/active. Returns an SzConfigResponse containing the currently active configuration exported from the engine.
Provides the implementation of GET /configs/template. Returns an SzConfigResponse containing a newly created default template configuration.

Provides the implementation for POST /data-sources/{dataSourceCode}/records. Loads a record with the specified data source code and optional load ID, with options to include resolution info and raw JSON.

endpoints.summary: Load a record with a specific record ID
endpoints.description: Provides the implementation for PUT /data-sources/{dataSourceCode}/records/{recordId}. Loads a record with the specified data source code and record ID, with options to include resolution info and raw JSON.

Provides the implementation for DELETE /data-sources/{dataSourceCode}/records/{recordId}. Deletes the record with the specified data source code and record ID, with options to include resolution info and raw JSON.

Provides the implementation for POST /data-sources/{dataSourceCode}/records/{recordId}/reevaluate. Reevaluates the record with the specified data source code and record ID, with options to include resolution info and raw JSON.
Provides the implementation for GET /data-sources/{dataSourceCode}/records/{recordId}. Retrieves the record with the specified data source code and record ID, with an option to include raw JSON.

Provides the implementation for GET /data-sources/{dataSourceCode}/records/{recordId}/entity. Retrieves the entity associated with the specified record, with options for related entities, detail level, feature mode, and raw JSON.
Provides the implementation for GET /entities/{entityId}. Retrieves the entity with the specified entity ID, with options for related entities, detail level, feature mode, and raw JSON.
Provides the implementation for GET /entities. Searches for entities based on attributes provided via query parameters, with options for filtering, detail level, feature mode, and raw JSON.
Provides the implementation for POST /search-entities. Searches for entities based on attributes provided in the request body, with options for filtering, detail level, feature mode, and raw JSON.
Provides the implementation for POST /reevaluate-entity. Reevaluates the entity with the specified entity ID, with options to include resolution info and raw JSON.

Implements the GET /entity-paths operation. Finds the path between two entities identified by the 'from' and 'to' parameters, with optional avoided entities, data source restrictions, and detail/feature options.

Implements the GET /entity-networks operation. Builds an entity network from one or more entities specified via 'e' or 'entities' parameters, with options for max degrees, build-out, max entities, and detail/feature options.

endpoints.summary: Get virtual entity by record IDs
endpoints.description: Implements the GET /virtual-entities operation. Retrieves the virtual entity formed by resolving the specified records. At least one record must be specified via the "r" or "records" query parameters.

endpoints.summary: How entity resolved by entity ID
endpoints.description: Implements the GET /entities/{entityId}/how operation. Describes how the entity with the specified entity ID resolved.

endpoints.summary: How entity resolved by record ID
endpoints.description: Implements the GET /data-sources/{dataSourceCode}/records/{recordId}/entity/how operation. Describes how the entity associated with the specified record resolved.
Implements the GET /data-sources/{dataSourceCode}/records/{recordId}/entity/why operation. Returns an SzWhyEntityResponse describing why the record belongs to its entity.
Implements the GET /entities/{entityId}/why operation. Returns an SzWhyEntityResponse describing why the entity is resolved as it is.
Implements the GET /why/records operation. Returns an SzWhyRecordsResponse describing why two records resolve to the same entity.
Implements the GET /why/entities operation. Returns an SzWhyEntitiesResponse describing why two entities are related.
